title: Cozy Cabin in the Woods
description:
This cozy cabin in the woods is the perfect peaceful getaway for a couple, family or small group of friends. It is only 30 minutes from  downtown Nashville so it is close enough to enjoy the city but far enough away to soak in some much needed peace and quiet.

The space
The cabin sits on a beautifully wooded 5 acre lot on a quiet street in the little town of Pegram, TN. The area is very quiet and peaceful, perfect for a relaxing getaway to rest and reset.

Guest access
You have the cabin and surrounding five acres all to yourself. It is a private and peaceful area located on a dead end street so it is very quiet.
